name: recruitee-mcp
description: Search, read and write your Recruitee / Tellent ATS from Claude, using your own personal API token.
long_description:
Reads offers, pipeline stages and candidates scoped correctly per offer, searches the whole candidate database including CV text, creates candidates onto a role, moves them along a pipeline, and writes interview evaluations and notes.

Everything is filed under YOUR name, because it runs on your own personal Recruitee API token rather than a shared one. There are no destructive tools: nothing here deletes a candidate, disqualifies anyone, or alters an offer.

api_token.title: Recruitee personal API token
api_token.description: Recruitee → Settings → Apps and plugins → API tokens → Personal API tokens → + Add token. It is shown once, so copy it straight in. Use your OWN token, never a shared one: a Recruitee token acts as the person who created it, so an evaluation written with it appears under your name.

company_id.title: Company ID or subdomain
company_id.description: On the same screen as the token, in the "Current company details" panel at the top. Either the numeric ID (e.g. 12345) or the subdomain (e.g. acme) works.

tools.name: rt_list_offers
tools.description: List the open roles (offers) on the account.

tools.name: rt_get_stages
tools.description: Read one offer's pipeline stages, in order.

tools.name: rt_offer_candidates
tools.description: List the candidates on one offer, scoped to that offer.

tools.name: rt_search_candidates
tools.description: Find candidates by name or keyword across the company.

tools.name: rt_source_candidates
tools.description: Search the whole candidate database, CV text included, to find people already in the ATS who fit a role.

tools.name: rt_create_candidate
tools.description: Create a candidate onto a role.

tools.name: rt_set_stage
tools.description: Move a candidate along an offer's pipeline.

tools.name: rt_attach_file
tools.description: Attach a file to a candidate.

tools.name: rt_get_rating_scale
tools.description: Read the account's evaluation rating scale.

tools.name: rt_get_evaluations
tools.description: Read the interview evaluations on a candidate.

tools.name: rt_submit_evaluation
tools.description: Write an interview evaluation onto a candidate.

tools.name: rt_get_notes
tools.description: Read the notes on a candidate.

tools.name: rt_add_note
tools.description: Add a note to a candidate.
